columns.name: historic
columns.description: Whether a later certificate has replaced this one for the property. False means the latest, which may have expired.

columns.name: building_reference_number
columns.description: Property identifier made by the Scottish EPC register. Present even when no UPRN matches. Not a UPRN.

columns.name: uprn
columns.description: Unique Property Reference Number, from the One Scotland Gazetteer. Blank when not matched.

columns.name: address1
columns.description: First line of the address.

columns.name: address2
columns.description: Second line of the address. Often blank.

columns.name: posttown
columns.description: Post town.

columns.name: postcode
columns.description: Postcode.

columns.name: inspection_date
columns.description: Date of the assessment.

columns.name: type_of_assessment
columns.description: Method of the assessment, such as RdSAP for an existing dwelling or SAP for a new one.

columns.name: lodgement_date
columns.description: Date the certificate was lodged on the register. Decides the yearly file it is in.

columns.name: energy_consumption_current
columns.description: Primary energy use per square metre of floor area.

columns.name: total_floor_area
columns.description: Total floor area. The publisher leaves out areas under 15 or over 1500.

columns.name: energy_cost_current_3yr
columns.description: Total current energy costs over 3 years.

columns.name: energy_savings_potential_3yr
columns.description: Potential energy savings over 3 years.

columns.name: current_energy_efficiency
columns.description: Current energy efficiency rating (SAP rating).

columns.name: current_energy_rating
columns.description: Current energy efficiency band, A to G.

columns.name: potential_energy_efficiency
columns.description: Potential energy efficiency rating, after the recommended improvements.

columns.name: potential_energy_rating
columns.description: Potential energy efficiency band, A to G.

columns.name: environment_impact_current
columns.description: Current environmental impact rating.

columns.name: current_environmental_rating
columns.description: Current environmental impact band, A to G.

columns.name: environment_impact_potential
columns.description: Potential environmental impact rating.

columns.name: potential_environmental_rating
columns.description: Potential environmental impact band, A to G.

columns.name: co2_emiss_curr_per_floor_area
columns.description: Current CO2 emissions per square metre of floor area.

columns.name: improvements
columns.description: Recommended improvements, as text.

columns.name: walls_description
columns.description: Description of the walls. Several parts are separated by ' | '.

columns.name: walls_energy_eff
columns.description: Energy efficiency of the walls, from Very Poor to Very Good.

columns.name: walls_env_eff
columns.description: Environmental efficiency of the walls, from Very Poor to Very Good.

columns.name: roof_description
columns.description: Description of the roof. Several parts are separated by ' | '.

columns.name: roof_energy_eff
columns.description: Energy efficiency of the roof, from Very Poor to Very Good.

columns.name: roof_env_eff
columns.description: Environmental efficiency of the roof, from Very Poor to Very Good.

columns.name: floor_description
columns.description: Description of the floor. Several parts are separated by ' | '.

columns.name: floor_energy_eff
columns.description: Energy efficiency of the floor, from Very Poor to Very Good.

columns.name: floor_env_eff
columns.description: Environmental efficiency of the floor, from Very Poor to Very Good.

columns.name: windows_description
columns.description: Description of the windows. Several parts are separated by ' | '.

columns.name: windows_energy_eff
columns.description: Energy efficiency of the windows, from Very Poor to Very Good.

columns.name: windows_env_eff
columns.description: Environmental efficiency of the windows, from Very Poor to Very Good.

columns.name: mainheat_description
columns.description: Description of the main heating. Several parts are separated by ' | '.

columns.name: mainheat_energy_eff
columns.description: Energy efficiency of the main heating, from Very Poor to Very Good.

columns.name: mainheat_env_eff
columns.description: Environmental efficiency of the main heating, from Very Poor to Very Good.

columns.name: mainheatcont_description
columns.description: Description of the main heating controls. Several parts are separated by ' | '.

columns.name: mainheatc_energy_eff
columns.description: Energy efficiency of the main heating controls, from Very Poor to Very Good.

columns.name: mainheatc_env_eff
columns.description: Environmental efficiency of the main heating controls, from Very Poor to Very Good.

columns.name: secondheat_description
columns.description: Description of the secondary heating. Several parts are separated by ' | '.

columns.name: sheating_energy_eff
columns.description: Energy efficiency of the secondary heating, from Very Poor to Very Good.

columns.name: sheating_env_eff
columns.description: Environmental efficiency of the secondary heating, from Very Poor to Very Good.

columns.name: hotwater_description
columns.description: Description of the hot water. Several parts are separated by ' | '.

columns.name: hot_water_energy_eff
columns.description: Energy efficiency of the hot water, from Very Poor to Very Good.

columns.name: hot_water_env_eff
columns.description: Environmental efficiency of the hot water, from Very Poor to Very Good.

columns.name: lighting_description
columns.description: Description of the lighting. Several parts are separated by ' | '.

columns.name: lighting_energy_eff
columns.description: Energy efficiency of the lighting, from Very Poor to Very Good.

columns.name: lighting_env_eff
columns.description: Environmental efficiency of the lighting, from Very Poor to Very Good.

columns.name: air_tightness_description
columns.description: Description of the air tightness. Several parts are separated by ' | '. New dwellings (SAP) only.

columns.name: air_tightness_energy_eff
columns.description: Energy efficiency of the air tightness, from Very Poor to Very Good. New dwellings (SAP) only.

columns.name: air_tightness_env_eff
columns.description: Environmental efficiency of the air tightness, from Very Poor to Very Good. New dwellings (SAP) only.

columns.name: co2_emissions_current
columns.description: Current CO2 emissions.

columns.name: co2_emissions_potential
columns.description: Potential CO2 emissions. The file's label says 'Potential Reduction in Emissions', so check before use.

columns.name: heating_cost_current_3yr
columns.description: Current heating costs over 3 years.

columns.name: heating_cost_potential_3yr
columns.description: Potential heating costs over 3 years.

columns.name: hot_water_cost_current_3yr
columns.description: Current hot water costs over 3 years.

columns.name: hot_water_cost_potential_3yr
columns.description: Potential hot water costs over 3 years.

columns.name: lighting_cost_current_3yr
columns.description: Current lighting costs over 3 years.

columns.name: lighting_cost_potential_3yr
columns.description: Potential lighting costs over 3 years.

columns.name: alternative_improvements
columns.description: Further improvement measures, as text.

columns.name: lzc_energy_sources
columns.description: Low and zero carbon energy sources, as text.

columns.name: space_heating_demand
columns.description: Space heating demand.

columns.name: water_heating_demand
columns.description: Water heating demand.

columns.name: impact_loft_insulation
columns.description: Change in energy use from loft insulation. Negative is a reduction.

columns.name: impact_cavity_wall_insulation
columns.description: Change in energy use from cavity wall insulation. Negative is a reduction.

columns.name: impact_solid_wall_insulation
columns.description: Change in energy use from solid wall insulation. Negative is a reduction.

columns.name: addendum_text
columns.description: Addenda from the assessor.

columns.name: construction_age_band
columns.description: Construction age band of the main building, in Scottish bands.

columns.name: floor_height
columns.description: Room height of the lowest storey.

columns.name: data_zone
columns.description: Data Zone (2001) code and name, such as 'S01005227 (Johnstone North West)'.

columns.name: energy_consumption_potential
columns.description: Potential primary energy use per square metre of floor area.

columns.name: extension_count
columns.description: Number of extensions.

columns.name: fixed_lighting_outlets_count
columns.description: Number of fixed lighting outlets.

columns.name: low_energy_fixed_lighting_outlets_count
columns.description: Number of low energy fixed lighting outlets.

columns.name: low_energy_lighting
columns.description: Share of fixed lighting outlets that are low energy.

columns.name: floor_level
columns.description: Floor of a flat, such as 'ground floor' or 'top floor'.

columns.name: flat_top_storey_number
columns.description: Storey number given for a flat. The publisher calls it the number of storeys in the block, but values such as -1 suggest a floor number.

columns.name: glazed_area
columns.description: Glazed area code: 0 new dwelling, 1 typical, 2 more, 3 less, 4 much more, 5 much less than typical.

columns.name: number_habitable_rooms
columns.description: Number of habitable rooms.

columns.name: heat_loss_corridor
columns.description: Corridor a flat loses heat to: no corridor, heated or unheated.

columns.name: number_heated_rooms
columns.description: Number of heated rooms.

columns.name: local_authority_label
columns.description: Name of the council, such as 'Edinburgh City'. No code is published.

columns.name: mains_gas_flag
columns.description: Whether the property has a mains gas connection. Blank in recent releases.

columns.name: main_heating_category
columns.description: Category of the main heating, such as 'boiler with radiators or underfloor heating'.

columns.name: main_fuel
columns.description: Fuel of the main heating.

columns.name: main_heating_controls
columns.description: SAP code of the main heating controls, such as '2102'.

columns.name: mechanical_ventilation
columns.description: Ventilation, such as 'natural' or 'mechanical, extract only'.

columns.name: energy_tariff
columns.description: Electricity meter type, such as 'Single' or 'dual'.

columns.name: multi_glaze_proportion
columns.description: Share of windows that are multiple glazed.

columns.name: glazed_type
columns.description: Type of multiple glazing.

columns.name: number_open_fireplaces
columns.description: Number of open fireplaces.

columns.name: photo_supply_description
columns.description: Photovoltaic arrays, as text. In England and Wales the same header is a percentage of roof area.

columns.name: solar_water_heating_flag
columns.description: Whether the property has solar water heating.

columns.name: tenure
columns.description: Tenure, such as 'owner-occupied' or 'rented (social)'.

columns.name: transaction_type
columns.description: Reason the certificate was made, such as a sale or a rental.

columns.name: unheated_corridor_length
columns.description: Length of the wall to an unheated corridor.

columns.name: ward
columns.description: Council ward code, such as '00RCMH'. Not a constituency, despite the header.

columns.name: ward_label
columns.description: Council ward name.

columns.name: wind_turbine_count
columns.description: Number of wind turbines.

columns.name: built_form
columns.description: Built form, such as 'Detached' or 'Mid-Terrace'.

columns.name: property_type
columns.description: Property type: House, Flat, Bungalow or Maisonette.

columns.name: data_zone_2011
columns.description: Data Zone (2011) code and name, such as 'S01012045 (Johnstone North West - 03)'.

columns.name: lodgement_datetime
columns.description: Date and time the certificate was lodged. Same day as lodgement_date.

columns.name: certificate_number
columns.description: Certificate number, such as '0123-4567-8901-2345-6789'. Blank for some certificates.
